title: When and How Should an Agent Clarify? CIGAsk: Teaching LLMs to Clarify via Counterfactual Information Gain
abstract: arXiv:2609.24290v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Instruction-tuned LLMs faced with underspecified queries often commit to a single interpretation rather than ask for clarification, producing confidently wrong answers. In our experiments, prompting alone is insufficient: models either ask for clarification on every query or ask vague questions that fail to recover the missing information. Addressing this failure requires learning two coupled skills: when to ask rather than answer and how to ask a question that recovers the disambiguating information. Existing recipes either address only one of these skills or require a separately trained critic. We propose CIGAsk, an RL recipe that teaches both skills through two complementary reward signals within a multi-turn GRPO loop. Counterfactual Information Gain (CIG) compares the gold-answer log-likelihood under a frozen reference model with and without the user response, providing per-turn credit that guides how to ask. The Asymmetric Ambiguit

translated_title: 智能体何时以及如何进行澄清？CIGAsk：通过反事实信息增益教会大语言模型进行澄清
translated_abstract: 指令微调的大语言模型在面对欠明确的查询时，往往倾向于单一解释而不请求澄清，从而产生自信但错误的答案。在我们的实验中，仅靠提示工程是不够的：模型要么对每个查询都请求澄清，要么提出无法恢复缺失信息的模糊问题。解决这一失败需要学习两种相互耦合的技能：何时提问而非直接回答，以及如何提出能够恢复消歧信息的问题。现有方法要么只针对其中一种技能，要么需要单独训练的评判器。我们提出CIGAsk，一种强化学习方案，通过多轮GRPO循环中两个互补的奖励信号来同时教授这两种技能。反事实信息增益通过比较冻结参考模型在有和没有用户响应情况下对标准答案的对数似然，提供逐轮次的信用分配来指导如何提问。非对称歧义……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CIGAsk强化学习方法，通过反事实信息增益等两类互补奖励信号，在多轮GRPO循环中同时教会大语言模型“何时提问澄清”与“如何提出有效澄清问题”这两项耦合技能。
en_tdlr: CIGAsk is an RL recipe that jointly teaches LLMs when to ask clarifying questions and how to ask informative ones, using Counterfactual Information Gain and complementary reward signals within a multi-turn GRPO loop.
